UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic AI slop layouts or neon gradients. Stick to clean, executive corporate developer aesthetics.
Ensure 100% responsiveness from mobile (320px) to ultra-wide desktop (1920px+).
Keep spacing generous (p-6, p-8, py-16, py-24) with strict grid alignment.
Do NOT add fake skill percentages or fake ratings (e.g. 90% C++ is forbidden).
Ensure smooth scrolling on anchor clicks using CSS scroll-behavior or custom JS handler.
Use Sonner for toast notifications when email/phone is copied to clipboard.
Verify that text contrast meets WCAG AA standards in both Light and Dark themes.
